name: History & compare
tagline: Commits, branches, tags, compare, new PR
summary: Commit history with search and an author filter, a single-commit diff page, branches grouped by activity, tags with source downloads, and a compare page that turns into the new pull request form.

flow.label: Compare route
flow.note: Parses base...head from the URL and prefetches the compare, branches, permission and open PR.

flow.label: ComparePage
flow.note: Shows the branch bar and diff, or swaps to the composer when ?expand=1 and access allows it.

flow.label: getCompareDetail
flow.note: Loads up to 300 commits and 300 changed files for base...head from GitHub's compare API.

flow.label: PullRequestComposer
flow.note: The shared draft page with title, body, branch pickers, a properties panel and the diff.

flow.label: createPullRequest
flow.note: Creates the PR with the user's token, then runs the label, assignee, milestone and reviewer calls.

flow.label: GitHub REST
flow.note: pulls.create, then follow-up calls; a failed follow-up comes back as a warning, not a failure.

features.name: Commit history
features.summary: Commits for any ref or path, grouped into today, yesterday, this week, last week and months, with message search, an author filter and paging.

entry.role: History page for both commits routes
Groups commits by recent period and month
Server read: list or search commits

features.name: Commit page
features.summary: One commit's diff in unified or split style with a changed-files sidebar. It reuses the review page's diff viewer and file sidebar.

entry.role: Server read: commit with its files

features.name: Branches page
features.summary: Default, active and stale sections (stale after 90 days), search, ahead and behind counts, and the most recent pull request per branch.

entry.role: Branches page with its four views
GraphQL branch list with tips and PRs

features.name: Tags page
features.summary: Tags newest first with their commit, a link to the release when one exists, and zip or tar.gz source downloads.

features.name: Compare page
features.summary: Pick a base and head, including owner:branch from a fork, see the commits and files, and jump to the PR already open for that pair.

entry.role: Compare page and its view states
Finds the open PR for a base and head

features.name: New pull request
features.summary: Written on the page it will become: title suggested from the single commit or the branch name, body from the repo's PR template, draft toggle, properties.

entry.role: The form, its submit and navigation
Draft state and the payload builder

features.name: Branch and tag picker
features.summary: One popover used on code and history pages. It loads the first 100 names of the shown kind when opened.

entry.role: Server read: branch or tag names

entryPoints.role: Compare states and when the composer takes over
Who may open a PR: pushers, or readers from a fork
Server reads for commits, branches, tags and refs

goodParts: URL parsing, branch sections, commit grouping and the PR draft are pure modules, each with a test file in lib (compare-ref.test.ts and four more).
e2e covers compare and PR creation end to end (apps/e2e/tests/concurrent/compare.spec.ts, isolated/create-pull-request.spec.ts).
watch: Compare loads at most 300 files and 3 pages of 100 commits; bigger ranges only get a truncation note (lib/github/repo-branches.ts:206-208).
Message search uses GitHub's commit index only on the default branch; on other refs it filters the loaded page (repo-commits-page.tsx:45-49).
lib/github/commits.ts is 636 lines and also holds the branch list, tag list, ref names and the ref resolver; compare-page.tsx is 531 lines.
